description: JMAP-4ii.48 was fixed in handlers.rs (added Value::Object guard) but 16 domain-specific handlers still use args["key"].take() on mut args: Value without the Object guard, so non-Object args cause a panic caught only by tokio::task::spawn. Affected handlers: chat-server: handle_chat_get (chat.rs:21), handle_chat_query (chat.rs:117), handle_space_get (space.rs:23), handle_space_query (space.rs:116), handle_message_get (message.rs:23), handle_message_query (message.rs:116), handle_contact_get (contact.rs:21), handle_contact_query (contact.rs:253), handle_emoji_get (emoji.rs:21), handle_emoji_query (emoji.rs:114), handle_position_get (position.rs:26), handle_presence_get (presence.rs:26), handle_ban_get (ban.rs:25), handle_invite_get (invite.rs:24); mail-server: handle_thread_get (thread.rs:20), handle_vacation_get (vacation.rs:31). Fix: add let Value::Object(mut args) = args else { return Err(JmapError::invalid_arguments("args must be an object")) } at the top of each handler, matching the pattern already in handle_chat_set, handle_space_set, handle_contact_set, and all the fixed handlers.rs handlers.
title: args["key"].take() panic in 16 domain handlers — incomplete JMAP-4ii.48 fix
